title: a repeat save answers a step whose fields have since changed
line: the plan rewrites a step's fields after its one logged run, so ran_unchanged says it was never asked on these; a row source's connector then answers the step on its current fields, which must not stand for the holder's own page (fetches.openable reads per step_source, the holder); the same rows saved again are still a repeat of the earlier artifact, and the fix reads the repeat path per step_source too, so it logs a none run under the holder on the step's current fields (the note naming the earlier artifact) instead of leaving the file in the inbox forever: the step is answered and the fetch list moves on

steps.say: the search saved once: a none run, the artifact logged on the step

expect.why: the first save is fresh: logged, not a repeat
answered on its current fields, the step is already off the list

steps.say: the plan rewrites the step's fields afterwards (a stand-in: a run written by hand on fields the step no longer carries, as a real field change would leave behind)

log.note: harness: standing in for the plan's own rewrite of this step's fields

expect.why: the step's latest run no longer matches its current fields, so a turn would send someone to it again

steps.say: a row source's connector answers the step on its current fields meanwhile (a stand-in: a run written by hand under C06, the row source, on the step's own fields as they stand) -- the holder itself still has nothing but the mismatched run

log.note: harness: standing in for a row source's connector answering the step on its current fields

expect.why: a row source's own run does not stand for the holder's page: the holder D03 has still not answered on the step's current fields, so the list still prints it

steps.say: the same page is saved again, other bytes, the same rows: still a repeat of the artifact the first save archived

expect.why: the rows are those the first save already archived
nothing new to archive: removed as a repeat

a fourth run, on the step's current fields again, is logged under the holder (D03), the step's own source, naming the earlier artifact, no artifact of its own -- not under C06, the row source that already answered these fields but does not stand for the holder's page

steps.say: the step is answered on its current fields once more: a turn does not pause on it

expect.why: the repeat's own run matches the step's current fields again, so the list moves on
